title: 第23章 血月鳝黑衣摊主第24章 屠氏酒谱评理
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
“岩甲牛的牛皮，上好的炼器材料，走过路过不要错过啊！”
“卖聚气丹喽，卖聚气丹喽，石松散人出品，必属精品。”
“火球符，火球符，物美价廉的火球符，买不了吃亏，买不了上当，火球符便宜卖喽！”
“灵芽米，今年新收的灵芽米，都来瞧一瞧，看一看。”
……
卯时已过，西市热闹了起来，耳边传来的吆喝声抑扬顿挫，此起彼伏，似乎和几天前的凡人在时没什么区别。
顾安慢悠悠的走着，不时停下来看看。
他没什么急需的东西，因此并不着急，抱着涨见识的心理逛了起来。
这一逛，还真让他看到不少稀罕东西。
黑蟾蜍的毒腺，火云蝎的钳子，紫源蜂的蜂蜜……
很多东西他在藏经阁里都没有看到过，即使看到过也没见过实物，这一路走下来，着实让他大开眼界！
蛇有蛇道，鼠有鼠道，散修，小家族也有自己的渠道弄到灵物。
就在青元宗的影子下，在两宗的夹缝里，这些人也能找到自己的生存之法，艰难求道。
当然，惊叹归惊叹，你要让他去当散修，顾安肯定是不愿意的。
背靠大树好乘凉，舒舒服服的当青元宗弟子不香吗？
没苦硬吃的事他可干不出来。
走走停停间，顾安来到一个摊位前，被摊位上的东西所吸引，不由得停下脚步。
只见这摊位上摆着三样东西，一只毒角蟒的毒角，四对寒玉蜘蛛的节肢，一个玉罐，能看到里面有什么东西影影绰绰的在动。
顾安对两样灵材不感兴趣，指着罐子问道：“这位道友，你这罐子里的是什么灵兽啊？”
摊主一袭黑衣，头上还戴着个斗笠，带有一股生人勿近的气质，也不吆喝，就坐在那里，听到顾安的话，才微微抬了抬眼皮，平静地说道：“一阶下品灵兽，血月鳝，食用类灵兽，三年方可成熟，食之可大补气血。”

声音如砂纸摩擦，沙哑刺耳，令人感到不适。
顾安却不在意其态度冷淡，只是用手打开玉罐的盖子，逗弄着里面一根根“血色细线”。
“嘶”这血月鳝幼苗似乎感受到血肉的气息，一口咬在那动来动去的手指上。
顾安赶紧甩掉，心中却微微一喜。
这灵兽，好像还不错啊！
当初顾安囊中羞涩，在青元仙城的百灵阁里只买了些黑灵鱼苗，如今稍稍富裕，自然要探索【灵源回馈】的更多可能性，收集更多灵兽，试试寿终正寝后会给什么回馈。
顾安装作不在意的样子，弹了弹手中的水渍，问道：“怎么卖啊？”
“血月鳝幼苗，两块灵石一条。”黑衣摊主的语气古井无波，仿佛不太在意这桩买卖能否成交。
顾安有些惊异，要知道，灵兽和灵兽也有很大不同，像那一阶上品白玉狐幼崽，掌控法术，善于斗法，能值两百多灵石，而一阶下品的黑灵鱼苗，一块灵石六条。
当然，二者用途不同，若都是成体灵兽，一阶下品的黑灵鱼能卖一块灵石，而白玉狐则是大幅度缩水，只值个百来块灵石。
就是不知这血月鳝有什么奇异之处，竟能卖到两块灵石一条鱼苗。
下意识的，顾安就不觉得这黑衣摊主在宰肥羊，一是因为这血月鳝看起来确实不凡，二是他好像真的不关心这桩生意能否成交。
content_en:
"The hide of the rock-armored cow is the best material for refining weapons. Don't miss it when you pass by!"
"I sell Qi Gathering Pills. I sell Qi Gathering Pills. This product is made by Shi Songsong. It must be a high-quality product."
"Fireball Talisman, Fireball Talisman, high-quality and low-priced Fireball Talisman. You can't buy it at a loss or be fooled. I sell the Fireball Talisman cheaply!"
"Lingya rice, the new Lingya rice harvested this year, come and take a look."
…
Mao hour has passed, and the West Market has become lively. The shouts coming from the ears are ups and downs, one after another, and they seem to be no different from the mortals a few days ago.
Gu An walked slowly, stopping to take a look from time to time.
He didn't have anything urgently needed, so he was not in a hurry and started shopping with the mentality of gaining knowledge.
During this visit, he really saw a lot of rare things.
The venom glands of the black toad, the pincers of the fire cloud scorpion, the honey of the purple source bee...
He had never seen many things in the Sutra Pavilion, and even if he had seen them, he had never seen them in real form. Going along this journey really opened his eyes!
Snakes have their own ways, rats have their own ways, and individual cultivators and small families also have their own channels to obtain spiritual objects.
Just under the shadow of the Qingyuan Sect, in the gap between the two sects, these people can also find their own way of survival and seek the truth with difficulty.
Of course, to be amazed, Gu An would definitely not be willing to let him become a casual cultivator.
Wouldn't it be nice to lean against a big tree to enjoy the shade and be a disciple of the Qing Yuan Sect comfortably?
He can't do anything without hard work.
While walking and walking, Gu An came to a stall and was attracted by the things on the stall, so he couldn't help but stop.
I saw three things on the stall, the poisonous horns of a poisonous horned python, four pairs of limbs of a cold jade spider, and a jade jar. Something could be seen vaguely moving inside.
Gu An was not interested in the two spiritual materials. He pointed at the jar and asked, "Fellow Taoist, what kind of spiritual beast is in your jar?"
The stall owner was dressed in black, with a hat on his head. He had an aura that kept strangers away, and he didn't yell. He just sat there. Hearing Gu An's words, he raised his eyelids slightly and said calmly: "The first-order low-grade spiritual beast, the blood moon eel, is an edible spiritual beast. It takes three years to mature. Eating it can greatly replenish the energy and blood."
The sound is like sandpaper rubbing, hoarse and harsh, making people feel uncomfortable.
Gu An didn't care about his cold attitude, he just opened the lid of the jade jar with his hand and teased the "bloody threads" inside.
"Hiss!" The blood-moon eel seedling seemed to feel the breath of flesh and blood, and bit into the moving fingers.
Gu An quickly shook it off, but felt a little happy in his heart.
This spiritual beast seems pretty good!
At first, Gu An was short of money and only bought some black spirit fish fry in the Bailing Pavilion in Qingyuan Immortal City. Now that he is a little richer, he naturally wants to explore more possibilities of [Spirit Source Feedback], collect more spirit beasts, and try out what kind of feedback he will get after he dies.
The customer pretended not to care, flicked the water stain in his hand, and asked, "How to sell it?"
"Blood moon eel seedlings, two spiritual stones and one spiritual stone." The black-clothed stall owner said in a calm tone, as if he didn't care much about whether the deal could be concluded.
Gu An was a little surprised. You must know that there is a big difference between spiritual beasts and spirit beasts. For example, the first-level high-grade white jade fox cub controls magic and is good at fighting, and can be worth more than two hundred spiritual stones, while the first-level low-grade black spirit fry has six spiritual stones per piece.
Of course, the two have different uses. If they are both adult spirit beasts, the first-level low-grade black spirit fish can be sold for one spirit stone, while the white jade fox has shrunk significantly and is only worth a hundred or so spirit stones.
I just don’t know what’s so strange about this Blood Moon Eel, that it can actually be sold for two spiritual stones and one fry.
Subconsciously, Gu An didn't feel that the stall owner in black was slaughtering a fat sheep. Firstly, because the blood-moon eel looked really extraordinary, and secondly, he seemed to really not care whether the business could be closed.
